---
title: "dc v6.5 pDC DEGs"
output: html_notebook
---
```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(slingshot)
```
```{r}
degls <- readRDS('~/scRNAseq/analysis/data/degls-2020-06-07.rds')
setDEGpdc = vector()
for (i in c(1,2,8)) {
  lessthen10 <- degls[[i]][degls[[i]]$p_val_adj<=1e-8 & degls[[i]]$avg_logFC<0,]
  print(nrow(lessthen10))
  setDEGpdc <- union(setDEGpdc, rownames(lessthen10))
}
setDEGpdc
dcpdc5 <- dcSubReg[['RNA']]@scale.data[setDEGpdc,]
dcpdc5 <- CreateSeuratObject(dcpdc5)
genotype <- dcSubReg@meta.data[, 'genotype']
dcpdc5 <- AddMetaData(object = dcpdc5, metadata = genotype, col.name = 'genotype')
pDCtime <- linTime[['pDC']]
dcpdc5 <- AddMetaData(object = dcpdc5, metadata = pDCtime, col.name = 'pDCtime')
dcpdc5lin <- subset(dcpdc5, cells = names(which(!is.na(dcpdc5$pDCtime))))
dcpdc5lin <- AddMetaData(object = dcpdc5lin, metadata = cut(dcpdc5lin$pDCtime, 10, labels = FALSE), col.name = 'pDCtimebin')

## not doing cluster, bin lintime instead
#dc255wt <- subset(dc255, idents = 'wt')
#dc255ko <- subset(dc255, idents = 'ko')
#cluster <- dcSubReg@meta.data[, 'seurat_clusters']
#cluster
#dcpdc5 <- AddMetaData(object = dcpdc5, metadata = cluster, col.name = 'cluster')
Idents(dcpdc5lin) <- 'genotype'
avepdc5lin <- AverageExpression(dcpdc5lin, add.ident = 'pDCtimebin')
dcpdc5linwt <- subset(dcpdc5lin, idents = 'wt')
dcpdc5linko <- subset(dcpdc5lin, idents = 'ko')
Idents(dcpdc5linwt) <- 'pDCtimebin'
Idents(dcpdc5linko) <- 'pDCtimebin'
avepdc5linwt <- AverageExpression(dcpdc5linwt)[[1]]
avepdc5linko <- AverageExpression(dcpdc5linko)[[1]]
write.csv(avepdc5linwt, "~/scRNAseq/analysis/data/avepdc5linwt.csv")
write.csv(avepdc5lin, "~/scRNAseq/analysis/data/avepdc5lin.csv")
write.csv(avepdc5linko, "~/scRNAseq/analysis/data/avepdc5linko.csv")
```
